Welcome to the Hyderabad twenty twenty-six Self Realization Tour. Here is how to pick your school, in about a minute.
Open the link. Today's schools are listed. Type your name and mobile number once. The page remembers them.
Each school is a card. Tap Details to see the contact person and remarks.
Tap Claim on a school. Your card turns green, and your name goes straight into the sheet.
Changed your mind? Tap Release, and your name is removed.
Registering a group? Tick Register others, and choose speakers from the list.
Now tap Claim. You, and everyone you ticked, are added together.
Prefer Telugu or Hindi? Just choose your language at the top.
That's it. Open the link, pick a date, and tap Claim.
